exposure: Google searches related to mode of birth
outcome: Trends in public interest regarding different birth methods
Correlation with real-world data (CS rate, fertility rate)
finding: Public interest in various birth-related topics, including cesarean section and vaginal delivery, has generally increased over the 15-year period, with regional search interest for cesarean section correlating with actual cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Global interest in 'Vaginal delivery' and 'Caesarean section' increased over the study period, while interest in 'Home birth' and 'Water birth' decreased.
